scripts.build: pnpm --filter @auction-bonanza/http-routing build && pnpm run build:deps && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:deps && vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:unit:coverage: pnpm run build:deps && vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts --coverage
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:deps && vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:integration:coverage: pnpm run build:deps && vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.ts --coverage
